betinsight.rule: Use the unchanged existing logo file; do not redraw, restyle or invent a replacement.

betinsight_fullsize_reference.rule: Reference candidate for larger layouts; verify visually against the approved brand before choosing it.

time_clash.rule: Approved clean 1024px wordmark. Keep pixels untouched; downscale only. Follow time-clash/assets/branding/README.md and time-clash-branding-guard.yml.

time_clash_seal.rule: Secondary element only, not a substitute for the approved TIME CLASH wordmark.

image_policy.social_cache_note: Use distinct image filenames per post and per meaningful revision.
